capabilities: Sync tasks marked #todoist from Obsidian to Todoist
Sync task changes from Todoist back to Obsidian
Map due dates, priorities, tags, and projects to Todoist fields
Run automatic synchronization on a configurable interval
Set a default Todoist project per file or vault-wide
extras: Many features are marked as coming soon (Todoist-to-Obsidian add/delete, task notes from Obsidian, reminders, moving tasks between files). The README includes a disclaimer stating the plugin is for learning purposes only and carries no warranty.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep tasks in Markdown checklists synchronized with an external task manager like Todoist.
summary: Todoist sync plugin that creates, updates, and completes Obsidian tasks in Todoist in both directions using the #todoist tag.
